title: Set up SSL certificates with Let's Encrypt and migrate production from PM2 to Docker
acceptance_criteria: Let's Encrypt certbot configured with auto-renewal cron job
SSL certificates mounted as Docker volumes in nginx container
Current PM2 deployment documented for rollback if needed
Docker Compose production deployment tested on staging DO droplet first
Migration cutover plan: DNS TTL lowered, health check confirmed, traffic switched to Docker
Old PM2 process stopped after confirming Docker deployment healthy
Deployment runbook updated with Docker commands and rollback procedures
